name: Shadow
tagline: Bot-free, on-device AI meeting assistant for Mac.
description: A macOS meeting assistant that detects calls at the operating-system level across Zoom, Meet, Teams, Webex and Discord without joining as a visible participant. Transcribes audio on-device, captures smart screenshots, and runs autonomous post-meeting Skills like notes, follow-up drafts, and CRM updates.
insight: Built by San Francisco's Taper Labs, founded by CEO Jay Song.
edge: Captures meetings at the OS level without joining as a bot, with transcription kept on-device — unlike notetakers that send a visible participant into the call.
pros: Generous free tier; Plus is just $8/mo
cons: AI features require the paid Plus tier
